function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the workspace. Returns content with 1-based line numbers. Read before editing.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files/directories under a workspace path (recursive). Skips .git, target, node_modules.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search the workspace for a pattern (uses ripgrep if available). Returns file:line: match lines. Use this before write_file to check whether equivalent logic already exists.

pattern.description: Regex or literal text to search for

path.description: Subdirectory to limit the search to

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Use edit_file for targeted changes to existing files. Prefer edit_file or extending an existing file; only use this for a genuinely new file.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Make a targeted edit using search/replace. The `search` block must appear EXACTLY ONCE in the file; it is replaced with `replace`. Provide multiple {search,replace} objects in `edits` to apply several edits in one call (applied in order).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

search.description: Exact text to find (must be unique). Omit if using `edits`.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command in the workspace root (build, lint, format, etc.). Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Run the project's test suite. Auto-detects the command (cargo test / npm test / pytest / go test) unless `command` is given.

function.name: update_instructions
function.description: Add a new instruction to the workspace instruction file (NASIKO.md) with a structured prompt comment recording why it was added. Use this when you discover a pattern, convention, or rule that should persist across future sessions — e.g. after fixing a recurring bug, discovering a project convention, or when the user asks you to remember something. The instruction is stored with rationale metadata so it can be maintained over time.

instruction.description: The instruction text (what the agent should do in future sessions)

trigger.description: What failure or observation led to this instruction (the 'why now')

hypothesis.description: Why this instruction should help (the expected benefit)

function.name: prune_instructions
function.description: Review and prune stale or unhelpful instructions from the workspace instruction file. Use this when the user asks to clean up, prune, or review their instructions. This triggers a review of all annotated instructions and revokes ones that are no longer relevant. Works regardless of the @pruning directive setting.

function.name: github_repo_info
function.description: Get info about a GitHub repository including stars, forks, open issues, language, and description.

function.name: github_actions_runs
function.description: List recent CI/CD workflow runs for a GitHub repository. Shows workflow name, status, conclusion, branch, and trigger event.

function.name: docker_hub_search
function.description: Search Docker Hub for container images. Returns image name, description, star count, pull count, and whether it's an official image.

query.description: Search query for Docker Hub images

function.name: check_endpoint
function.description: Check if an HTTP endpoint is responding and measure its latency. Reports status code, response time, content-type, and health status.

url.description: The URL to check (must include scheme, e.g. https://example.com)

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for DevOps documentation, tutorials, best practices, or troubleshooting guides. Use when existing tools don't cover the question.

function.name: crates_io
function.description: Search crates.io for Rust crates. Returns name, version, description, and documentation links. Use when the user asks about Rust libraries.

function.name: crate_info
function.description: Get detailed info about a specific Rust crate: version history, features, dependencies, and docs.rs link.

function.name: npm_search
function.description: Search npm for JavaScript/TypeScript packages. Returns name, version, description. Use for Node.js/frontend library questions.

function.name: npm_package
function.description: Get detailed info about a specific npm package: versions, dependencies, repository, and README excerpt.

function.name: pypi_package
function.description: Get info about a Python package from PyPI: version, description, dependencies, and project links.

function.name: github_readme
function.description: Fetch the README of a GitHub repository. Use for understanding how to use a library when registry docs aren't enough.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information. Use when you need to find documentation, blog posts, comparisons, or any information not available through package registries. Good for 'latest', 'best', 'comparison' queries.

function.name: exchange_rates
function.description: Get current exchange rates for a base currency. Returns conversion rates against other currencies.

targets.description: Optional list of target currency codes (e.g. ["EUR", "GBP"]). If omitted, returns top 10 rates.

function.name: crypto_price
function.description: Get current price and market data for a cryptocurrency. Use the CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. "bitcoin", "ethereum", "solana").

function.name: crypto_search
function.description: Search for a cryptocurrency by name or symbol. Useful when you don't know the exact CoinGecko ID for a coin.

query.description: Search query (name or symbol, e.g. "bitcoin" or "BTC")

function.name: crypto_market
function.description: Get top cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap. Returns prices, 24h changes, and market caps.

function.name: public_holidays
function.description: Get public holidays for a country and year. Returns holiday dates, names, and whether they are fixed or regional.

function.name: working_days
function.description: Calculate the number of working/business days between two dates, excluding weekends and public holidays for the given country.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code for public holidays (e.g. "US", "DE", "JP")

function.name: world_clock
function.description: Get the current time in a specific timezone. Returns datetime, UTC offset, day of week, week number, and DST status.

function.name: country_info
function.description: Get country information including capital, region, income level, and latest population (World Bank data). Useful for understanding labor markets and regional context.

function.name: terraform_modules
function.description: Search the Terraform Registry for modules. Returns module names, versions, descriptions, and download counts. Use for finding reusable infrastructure modules.

function.name: terraform_provider
function.description: Get information about a Terraform provider from the registry. Returns version, description, source repository, downloads, and tier (official/partner/community).

function.name: dns_lookup
function.description: Resolve DNS records for a domain using Google's DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns answer records with TTL and data. Useful for diagnosing DNS issues or verifying configurations.

record_type.description: DNS record type to query (default: A)

function.name: ssl_check
function.description: Connect to a domain over TLS and inspect its certificate: issuer (CA), subject, validity dates, days until expiry, and whether it's trusted by public root CAs.

function.name: ip_info
function.description: Get geolocation and network information for an IP address. Returns country, region, city, timezone, ISP, organization, and AS number.

function.name: sec_filing_search
function.description: Full-text search of SEC EDGAR filings. Search for keywords across all SEC filings including 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more. Useful for finding disclosures, risk factors, financial statements, and regulatory filings.

query.description: Search query for full-text search across SEC filings

start_date.description: Start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format

end_date.description: End date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format

function.name: sec_company_filings
function.description: Get recent SEC filings for a specific company by CIK number. Returns the company's most recent filings including form type, date, and description. CIK numbers can be found on the SEC EDGAR website.

cik.description: Company CIK number (will be zero-padded to 10 digits automatically)

function.name: sec_company_search
function.description: Look up a public company's SEC CIK number by name or ticker. Use this before sec_company_filings, which requires a CIK rather than a company name.

name.description: Company name or ticker symbol to search for (e.g. 'Apple', 'AAPL')

function.name: federal_register
function.description: Search the U.S. Federal Register for regulations, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents. The Federal Register is the official daily publication for rules, proposed rules, and notices of federal agencies.

query.description: Search query for Federal Register documents

document_type.description: Filter by document type: RULE (final rules), PRRULE (proposed rules), NOTICE (notices), PRESDOCU (presidential documents)

function.name: case_law_search
function.description: Search for court opinions and case law via CourtListener. Find judicial opinions from federal and state courts including the Supreme Court, Circuit Courts, and District Courts.

query.description: Search query for case law (supports natural language and legal citations)

court.description: Filter by court identifier (e.g. 'scotus' for Supreme Court, 'ca1'-'ca11' for Circuit Courts)

function.name: search_food
function.description: Search the USDA FoodData Central database for foods. Returns food names with IDs that can be used for detailed nutrition lookup.

query.description: Food item to search for (e.g. 'chicken breast', 'brown rice', 'avocado')

data_type.description: Optional — leave UNSET for ordinary foods and ingredients; the search already covers whole foods (Foundation + SR Legacy) by default. Set 'Branded' only for a specific packaged supermarket product. Never re-run the same query with a different value.

function.name: get_nutrition
function.description: Get detailed nutrition facts for a specific food by its FDC ID. Returns calories, macros, vitamins, and minerals per 100g.

function.name: open_food_facts
function.description: Search Open Food Facts for packaged/branded food products by name or barcode. Returns nutrition labels, ingredients, and Nutri-Score.

query.description: Product name or barcode to search for

function.name: compare_foods
function.description: Compare nutrition of multiple foods side by side. Takes a list of FDC IDs and returns a comparison table.

fdc_ids.description: List of FoodData Central IDs to compare (2-5 items)

function.name: arxiv_search
function.description: Search arXiv for academic papers. Returns titles, authors, abstracts, and links. Use for finding research papers on any scientific or technical topic.

query.description: Search query (supports arXiv query syntax: ti:, au:, abs:, cat:)

function.name: semantic_scholar
function.description: Search Semantic Scholar for papers with citation counts, influential citations, and related work. Better for finding highly-cited or influential papers.

year.description: Filter by year or range (e.g. '2024' or '2022-2024')

function.name: semantic_scholar_paper
function.description: Get detailed info about a specific paper by its Semantic Scholar ID, arXiv ID, or DOI. Returns abstract, citations, references, and TL;DR.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier: Semantic Scholar ID, 'arXiv:2301.00001', or 'DOI:10.xxx/yyy'

function.name: wikipedia_summary
function.description: Get a Wikipedia summary for a topic. Useful for providing context, definitions, or background on concepts mentioned in papers.

function.name: search_books
function.description: Search Open Library for books by title, author, subject, or free-text query. Returns top matches with authors, first publish year, page count, rating, and subjects.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'Isaac Asimov', 'history of Rome', or 'machine learning'

function.name: search_repos
function.description: Search GitHub repositories by keyword, sorted by stars. Returns the top 10 matches.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'rust async runtime' or 'a2a protocol'

function.name: get_repo
function.description: Get an overview of a repository: description, stars, forks, open issues, language, license, topics.

function.name: get_readme
function.description: Fetch the README of a repository.

function.name: get_contents
function.description: List the contents of a directory in a repository, or read a file's contents. Leave path empty for the repository root.

path.description: Path inside the repo, e.g. 'src/net'. Empty string means the repo root.

function.name: top_stories
function.description: Get the current top stories from the Hacker News front page.

function.name: search_stories
function.description: Search Hacker News (via Algolia) for stories matching a query.

function.name: get_item
function.description: Get details (title, score, author, comments, URL) for a Hacker News item by its numeric ID.

function.name: geocode
function.description: Resolve a place name (city, region, landmark) to coordinates and a canonical name.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get current conditions and a 3-day forecast for coordinates from geocode.
